title: Msc-Dissertation-Pipeline
summary: A pipeline of Jupyter notebooks comparing synthetic data generation methods (Gaussian Copula, CTGAN, TVAE) on a clinical cohort dataset for a Master's dissertation. SDV's single-table synthesizers (GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer) are run and hyperparameter-tuned directly via the sdv library to generate and evaluate synthetic patient data.
